messages:
olivia: FYI i bumped into a weird pctl mismatch on the latency dashboard for /v1/respond. p50/p95 look sane but p99 is wildly higher for a single client cohort (third-party-proxy).
samir: can you paste the console slice?
olivia: ```select percentile(0.50, duration_ms), percentile(0.95, duration_ms), percentile(0.99, duration_ms), count(*) from requests where endpoint='/v1/respond' and client='third-party-proxy' and time >= now() - interval '30 minutes'```
olivia: results: p50=45ms, p95=180ms, p99=820ms, count=22.
hannah: small-n effect + rollup provenance often causes this. are those values coming from merged rollups (tdigest) or raw compute?
telemetry-bot: rollup_meta: codec=tdigest, compression=80, rollup_variant=legacy_include_retries, indexed_at=2026-03-12T07:10:00Z.
samir: legacy_include_retries? oh— that variant includes retried requests and fallback fanouts by default. that could explain the tail.
olivia: interesting. i tried the same query against raw events and p99 drops to 210ms (so retries/fanout appear to be the cause).
hannah: UX thread: for SLO tiles we agreed earlier to bake in a stable rollup_variant. product asked for minimal surprises. product-bot: product-note: Ben requests SLO tiles to reflect user-visible latencies not internal retry inflation.
samir: telemetry proposal: write two co-located rollups per key: variant=stable_slo (filters is_retry=true and excludes fanout_count>3) and variant=full_raw. rollup documents should include headers: sample_count, retry_count, fanout_p95, codec, compression. console can pick variant by tile type.
hannah: UI: default SLO tiles -> stable_slo rollup. In breakdown panes show a small provenance pill: "SLO view" with an option to "Show raw (includes retries)" that toggles to the full_raw variant. Tooltip should show retry_ratio and sample_count.
mike: ops ask: how will this affect historical SLOs? if we start surfacing stable_slo from today, historical charts might jump. we need a backfill plan or a migration guide.
samir: plan: 1) add rollup_variant and headers to new rollups immediately; 2) backfill normalized stable_slo rollups for last 90 days for high-traffic endpoints only; 3) keep legacy rollups intact and add migration shim that saved charts default to legacy variant until product approves cutover.
telemetry-bot: ticket telemetry#6120 created: "emit rollup_variant + metadata; produce stable_slo rollups".
product-bot: ticket product#77 created: "review backfill impact and approve SLO default switch".
hannah: console work: add provenance pill + toggle and a small low-sample warning (n<50) that collapses pctl into a raw list on click. i'll own the console PR.
mike: i'll coordinate an ops window for the backfill and run a diff job to produce per-endpoint p99 delta. if delta > 5% we warn product.
olivia: thanks — please @channel when rollups land so I can re-check the canary slices. this caused a false alarm during incident triage.
samir: note for implementers: when computing tdigest rollups for stable_slo, ensure we apply identical compression params across shards so merges are stable. also record codec/compression in headers.
hannah: will mock the pill & toggle copy: "SLO view (filtered) — excludes retries & large fanouts. Show raw to include all events".
olivia: cool. moving the dashboard card to monitoring->investigate until we see backfill diff. end.
